headline: Tripadvisor CEO Matt Goldberg to Step Down Amid Business Overhaul
summary: Tripadvisor Chief Executive Officer Matt Goldberg will step down as the travel platform pursues a corporate restructuring while facing consumer price-sensitivity and elevated operational costs.
why: Tripadvisor is a major online travel review and booking services operator globally.

impacts.name: Tripadvisor, Inc.
impacts.why: Executive departure amidst high consumer price sensitivity creates strategic uncertainty for the online travel agency.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Leadership changes and persistent consumer caution around travel spending prompted stock pressure.
